verdict.rationale: Name.com can be driven entirely headlessly through its Core API, which uses HTTP Basic Auth with API tokens. Separate development and production tokens can be issued, and official TypeScript, Go and PHP SDKs are available. A sandbox environment is explicitly offered for running automated integration tests without touching real domains or incurring charges. Missing for 10: no official CLI or CI-specific guides (e.g., pipeline examples), no published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
